sources.title: GitHub - Celestios/simkgc_pipeline
sources.snippet: Vocabulary Pruning: Slices off unused scripts, keeping strictly Persian (\u0600-\u06FF) and English (a-zA-Z), reducing embedding table size by ~60%. Matryoshka 256d + 128d: Multi-dimensional InfoNCE contrastive loss allows high-speed dot products on 256-d normalized vectors.
